dataset_metadata.description: A specialized financial dataset containing parsed sections (Items) of Form 10-K annual reports for historical S&P 500 constituents from 2010 to 2022. It maps qualitative disclosures (Risk Factors, MD&A) to quantitative financial outcomes such as stock returns and market capitalization.

schema_analysis.description: Central Index Key; a unique identifier assigned by the SEC to filing entities.
The legal name of the corporation filing the 10-K.
The official filing date of the document in the SEC EDGAR system.
Text content of the 15 standard sections of a 10-K (e.g., Item 1: Business, Item 1A: Risk Factors, Item 7: MD&A).
The market capitalization of the company at the time of filing.
Forward-looking stock performance metrics calculated over various windows following the filing date.

structural_logic.relationships: The 'item_x' columns provide high-dimensional textual context that explains the corporate state, while 'cik' and 'date' serve as the primary keys to link these disclosures to the corresponding 'return' columns.
structural_logic.label_dynamics: Financial returns are continuous numeric values, making the dataset suitable for regression tasks or market impact sentiment analysis.
structural_logic.potential_bottlenecks: Significant textual sparsity in specific sections (e.g., Item 1B or Item 4) which often contain 'None' or boilerplate. Additionally, the extreme length of 'item_7' and 'item_8' poses challenges for transformer-based context windows.
